questions: When a bill does not split evenly, who should get the extra pesewa: the first members in the list, members chosen at random, or some other rule?
Should each friend have their own login, so only group members can see and add to a group, or is one shared access fine?
Do you need to edit or delete expenses and paybacks after they are recorded, or remove members from a group?
answers: Any of them, as long as the shares differ by at most one pesewa and add up to the bill.
